rule: Last NYSE trading day of June from 2012: rank eligible non-financial US stocks by rank(book/market)+rank(gross profit/assets) using first-reported 10-K values filed before that date. Hold 10 names; sell outside top 20 percent; fill from unheld top 10 percent; fill at next open.
known_bias: Prices exist only for companies listed in 2026. Survivorship favours passing, so a pass cannot be promoted without delisted-price data.
